facts.fact: Guinea's UCEP published the award on 5 October 2026 of a 12-month, USD 26,400 consultancy, signed 7 September 2026, to set up, manage and optimise the Tribunal de Commerce de Conakry's integrated management, archiving and digital communication system, with its website, case-law database and IT estate.
